When डट् follows, थुक् is the augment of the words 1. षट् 2. कति 3. कतिपय and 4. चतुर्।

Terms: डट् and (थुक्)
The case-endings beginning with a consonant, have the acute accent after the Numerals called षट्

, as well as after त्रि and चतुर् ।

Terms: accent-विभक्ति
The six words - 1. काण्ड 2. चीर 3. पलल 4. सूप 5. शाक and 6. कूल of sūtras

-129 preceded by a non-living Genitive 6th-Case word have acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

Terms: समास end acute-2nd-term

The augment न् is added before the Genitive 6th-Case plural ending आम् after the numerals called षष् and after चतुर्।

Terms: नुम् / नुट् augment
